HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 30.01.2026 CRL.M.A. 3183-3184/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 1/2024 of Police Station Mukherjee Nagar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the respondent no. 2 has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.

3. At the outset, learned counsel for petitioners seeks and is allowed one week to file amended memo of parties and add one more petitioner/accused.
4.
Learned APP accepts notice and submits that State has no objection to this petition.
5. Respondent no.2 identified by IO/SI Pawan also accepts notice.
6. List before the concerned Joint Registrar for recording of statements of parties on 10.03.2026.
